notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Simulating CD40-driven NF-κB dynamics with SOCS1 negative feedback from adjustable rate constants, comparing it with a no-feedback model, stress-testing it with Monte Carlo parameter noise, and ranking CRISPR knockout targets by AUC-based synergy. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
